test_cases.name: Bucket enumeration via KooCLI obsutil (read-only, limit 1)
test_cases.expected: Bucket number is: N + obs:// bucket names (account-level list)

test_cases.name: Whole-account aggregate statistics (table)
test_cases.expected: Table: bucket count / object count / total capacity / storage-class & region distributions

test_cases.name: Single-bucket aggregate statistics (prefix scope, table)
test_cases.expected: Table restricted to the bucket + prefix

test_cases.name: Markdown output
test_cases.expected: Markdown report with summary / distribution tables

test_cases.name: SDK fallback path
test_cases.expected: Same report shape as the CLI path

test_cases.name: Write intent rejected (read-only guard)
test_cases.expected: Exit 1, stderr contains 检测到写操作意图

notes: 只读聚合统计（ListBuckets / ListObjects），无资源创建/修改/删除风险。CLI 路径使用 hcloud OBS（obsutil）的 ls；SDK 回退使用 huaweicloudsdkobs。TEST_OBS_BUCKET / TEST_OBS_PREFIX 未设置时脚本自身回退为账号级统计。
